CVE-2026-11065.title: Use after free in ANGLE in Google Chrome prior to 149.0.7827.53 a ...
CVE-2026-11065.description: Use after free in ANGLE in Google Chrome prior to 149.0.7827.53 allowed a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

CVE-2026-110654.title: libzvbi through 0.2.45 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerabil ...
CVE-2026-110654.description: libzvbi through 0.2.45 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Teletext decoder that allows attackers to corrupt memory by supplying unvalidated DRCS pixel-mode values in X/28/3 packets. Attackers can send a crafted Teletext stream decoded via vbi_decode with every slot set to DRCS_MODE_6_5_4, causing convert_drcs to overflow chars[48][60] and crash the application.
